description: SriLankan Airlines FlySmiLes miles for SriLankan Airlines flights. Miles = distance x booking-class % (J 225; C 200; D 175; I, Y, B, P, H 150; K, W, M, E 125; L, R, V, S 100; N, Q, O 60; G 50), rounded down, no minimum; T, U, X, Z, A and F are not listed. The 25% Platinum and 15% Gold bonus is a note only (SriLankan does not say what it is a share of), and tier miles are not calculated. Give segs: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and the ISO country codes of its two airports. Takes no price. Uses cwsi.net's calculator and the airline's published rules. Unofficial.

cls.description: Booking class. J = J (Business Flex 225%); C = C (Business Semi Flex 200%); D = D (Business Value 175%); I = I (Business Saver 150%); Y = Y (Economy Flex 150%); B = B (Economy Flex 150%); P = P (Economy Flex 150%); H = H (Economy Flex 150%); K = K (Economy Semi Flex 125%); W = W (Economy Semi Flex 125%); M = M (Economy Semi Flex 125%); E = E (Economy Semi Flex 125%); L = L (Economy Value 100%); R = R (Economy Value 100%); V = V (Economy Value 100%); S = S (Economy Value 100%); N = N (Economy Saver 60%); Q = Q (Economy Saver 60%); O = O (Economy Saver 60%); G = G (Economy (G class) 50%). The letter on your ticket. J, C, D and I are Business; the rest are Economy. Classes FlySmiLes does not list (T, U, X, Z, A, F) are not offered.

creditClass.description: The booking class letter for creditTo, when it differs from the class question. Ignored without creditTo.

creditFlights.description: The flights for creditTo: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and optionally from/to airport codes. Defaults to segs when they carry miles.

from.description: The departure airport's code; labels the breakdown.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's code; labels the breakdown.

creditStatus.description: Your status in the creditTo program, by its name as listed under creditTo. Defaults to the base level. Ignored without creditTo.

creditTo.description: Credit the flights to a partner program instead of SriLankan Airlines's own: american = American AAdvantage (creditStatus one of: AAdvantage member, AAdvantage Gold, AAdvantage Platinum, AAdvantage Platinum Pro, AAdvantage Executive Platinum); alaska = Atmos Rewards (creditStatus one of: Atmos Rewards member, Atmos Silver, Atmos Gold, Atmos Platinum, Atmos Titanium); ba-club = British Airways Club (creditStatus one of: Blue, Bronze, Silver, Gold). Earns by each flight's distance and the booking class at the program's published partner rates; leave creditTo out for the airline's own program. The booking class is cls (or creditClass). The flights are segs (their miles), or creditFlights.

segs.description: The flights, one way and in order, one entry per flight (1 to 8): fromCountry and toCountry, the ISO 3166 two-letter country codes of its two airports; miles, its great-circle distance in miles (1 to 12,500); optional from and to, the IATA codes of its two airports, which label the breakdown; some airlines also use them (Vladivostok, VVO, on JAL and ANA; the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle, MAD-BCN, on Iberia; the long-haul tables named by city on SAS).

from.description: The departure airport's IATA code, e.g. SYD. Labels the breakdown; JAL and ANA use it to spot Vladivostok (VVO), Qantas to pick its route tables, Iberia to spot the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle (MAD, BCN), and SAS to pick its long-haul tables (named by city).

fromCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the departure airport, e.g. DE.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's IATA code, e.g. SYD. Labels the breakdown; JAL and ANA use it to spot Vladivostok (VVO), Qantas to pick its route tables, Iberia to spot the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle (MAD, BCN), and SAS to pick its long-haul tables (named by city).

toCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the arrival airport, e.g. DE.

status.description: Your FlySmiLes tier. BL = Blue; CL = Classic; GD = Gold; PL = Platinum. Gold and Platinum get a 15% and 25% tier bonus on flights SriLankan markets and operates; it is explained below the result, not added.

trip.description: Trip. ow = One way; rt = Round trip. Round trip counts the same flights back the other way.
